stewards.name: UCP Governing Council
stewards.role: Owns all UCP assets; 5 seats (Google and Shopify permanent, Stripe elected, 2 open as of 2026-10-11).

stewards.name: Google
stewards.role: Launched UCP, holds a permanent seat and the proxy vote for open seats until December 2028, custodian of ucp.dev.

stewards.name: Domain Tech Councils (Shopping, Food, Lodging, Payments)
stewards.role: 16-seat councils (some seats permanent), members elected every 6 months; Payments council includes Adyen, Ant International, Coinbase, Global Payments, PayPal and Stripe.

implementers.name: Google AI Mode in Search and Gemini
implementers.role: Platform; UCP checkout for US shoppers, starting with Etsy and Wayfair on 2026-02-11.

implementers.name: Etsy and Wayfair
implementers.role: Businesses live on Google surfaces from 2026-02-11.

implementers.name: Shopify, Target and Walmart
implementers.role: Businesses; Google said on 2026-02-11 that their checkout through UCP was coming soon.

implementers.name: Shopify merchants (native checkout on Google)
implementers.role: Reported automatic enrollment of eligible US merchants around 2026-09-22 (secondary only).

implementers.name: Google Universal Cart
implementers.role: Google shopping product that uses UCP for checkout (announced 2026-05-19).

implementers.name: Microsoft Copilot Checkout and Merchant Center
implementers.role: Copilot Checkout requires a UCP-compliant feed; Microsoft says MMC will support UCP (future tense).

implementers.name: Stripe
implementers.role: Documents a Stripe Payments handler for UCP.

implementers.name: Adyen
implementers.role: Documents a UCP Tokenization Handler bound to checkout session and merchant.

sdks.name: @ucp-js/sdk
sdks.note: Zod schemas and TypeScript types; published 2026-09-02.

sdks.name: ucp-schema
sdks.note: Runtime resolution of UCP schema annotations; 2026-08-03.

metrics.caveat: Google appears in three verticals (23 logo slots); a count of names, not of integrations.

metrics.definition: Names in the endorser list on the homepage.
Google's statement about tech, payments and retail companies.
No merchant count or volume from Google or the project.

costs.caveat: Platform and PSP fees are separate from the protocol.

costs.item: Google cut of agentic checkout sales
costs.value: Google told The Register it does not plan to take a cut
costs.caveat: A statement of intent to a reporter, not a published fee schedule.

costs.value: The merchant's normal PSP fees, presumably; the PSP must be able to process Google's tokens
costs.caveat: An inference from the merchant-of-record and PSP roles; Google's FAQ does not mention fees and no fee schedule exists.

costs.item: Google AI Mode, Gemini and Microsoft Copilot checkout fees
costs.caveat: Reported by PYMNTS citing The Information, in contrast to a 4% ChatGPT checkout fee for Shopify merchants.

costs.item: Google Pay on Google AI surfaces
costs.caveat: Affects which credentials reach the PSP, not a fee.
